name: Exciting Items
description: Needs the Exciting build of LocalExile (github.com/marshmellion/LocalExile, branch exciting). Works with Quality of Life (its gem panel lists the alternate quality gems) and any loot filter (HasEnchantment "Exciting"). Rare chances on magic, rare and unique drops: a unique item's modifier as an extra implicit, an empowered modifier 10-100% above its roll, and one modifier more than the item could have, fractured with its side; they can all land on one item.
author: marshmellion
